notes.content:

The game will also be half off between 5/27/2022 - 6/3/2022.

notes.title: Halloween 2021 Sale
notes.content: It's that time of year again to dress up, grab some candy, and bring your flashlights along! In this case, You'll want your magical wands to help you through the darkness. From 10/28/21-11/1/2021, Hyde & Zeke will be 50% off!  Please let us know if you encounter any bugs in the community forum, and check out our [url=https://twitter.com/MysticMaskMedia]Twitter[/url] to see what we have been up to lately!

Hyde & Zeke is going to be 1 year in the making next week! Join us for a Dev Stream next week on Wednesday 6/2/2021 at 3:00 PM EST on our twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/mysticmaskmedia . notes.title: Hyde & Zeke On Sale!
notes.content: Hello everyone, it's been two months since we released Hyde & Zeke!  We still would love to see our community grow, so we've put the game on sale in commemoration of this time!  Please let us know if you encounter any bugs in the community forum, and check out our [url=https://twitter.com/MysticMaskMedia]Twitter[/url] to see what we have been up to lately!

notes.title: Hyde and Zeke Unlocks Its Doors Today!
notes.content:
Don your wizard robes and sneak your way through Hyde & Zeke today!  Guide the young wizard Hyde through the dark halls of an eerie castle.  Be wary though of the robed Zeke as he follows and tries to capture Hyde.  Use the light magic and layout of the castle at your disposal to find all the keys and escape the castle! 

We hope you all enjoy the game.  Feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/2uAt6F9]Discord[/url], or visit our community discussion if you are having issues or simply would like to discuss the game.  Thank you to all our fans and supporters!

notes.title: Win a Free Copy of Hyde & Zeke!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Light Mages!

We are offering a chance to receive a free copy of Hyde & Zeke on our Discord!  Simply join our [url=https://discord.gg/2uAt6F9]Discord[/url] and post in the #hyde_and_zeke_contest channel with the answer to, "Why do you think Hyde is in the castle?"  We'll be picking the winner based on what we feel is the most creative answer.  Make us laugh, cry, or anything else you think will catch our attention, so don't worry about accuracy of the answer!  Please keep the answers PG-13 though.
